notes: UpdateSourcesThreaded forwarder: vtable +0x18 on the internal engine; the target UpdateSources is now ported (voxengine_create_emitter.cpp)
CreateEmitterAsync forwarder: calls VoxEngineInternal::CreateEmitterAsync or returns the null handle; the target is ported but DriverAndroid creates no source, so it returns null on that driver
CreateEmitter forwarder: calls VoxEngineInternal::CreateEmitter or returns the null handle; the target is ported but DriverAndroid creates no source, so it returns null on that driver
DataObj D1: list nodes, state mutex and Handlable mutex released by the members (std::list frees the 16-byte nodes); D0 is compiler-generated
GetDuration: float bits of length / sample rate under the mutex, 0 unless ready
GetDebugInfo: fills DebugChunk_dataSource (layout from the writes at +0x00..+0x28); stream and decoder types via GetType
PrintDebug: GetDuration then lock and unlock; the binary prints nothing
ShouldDie: empty list and zero refcount give true; else need_to_die gives true; else state == -1. The sentinel walk has no effect and is not repeated
UnregisterEmitter(int64): removes the first node with the id; the node holds the id only (16 bytes in the original)
RegisterEmitter(int64): appends an id node under the mutex

EmitterObj C1 (id, priority, bank, source, data): field defaults, fades, 3D block and rate/length from the data object. Partial: the unnamed words +0x120, +0x124, +0x128, +0x12c and +0x130 are not stored
EmitterObj C2: same body as C1 (0x866380); partial for the same unnamed words

DataObj::Update: source flags 0, 1 and 2 (cursor, buffered stream, decoded stream) with state -1 and 0 as the original. Partial: track words come from the decoder GetParam block, since the port cursors have none; a decoder returning null (MSWav, MPC8) leaves the params unset
GetDataObject: the stamp fast path, then data_objects_ and data_pending_ by id, then SetTimeStamp(stamp, slot). The second argument is the object slot (ARM r2), which the port passes

CreateEmitterAsync: driver source, emitter, group, data registration and pending add. Partial: the track words come from the data object and DriverAndroid::CreateDriverSource is a stub that returns null, so no emitter is created on the Android driver
UpdateSources: no-op while suspended; merges the pending data, then pops the release queue once: dying objects are detached and released, the rest updated under the read access

EmitterObj C1 (id, priority, bank, chunk, source, cursor, data): buffer ring from the source and cursor. Partial: rate and length come from the data object (cursor words not in the port); the unnamed words are not stored

CreateEmitter: stream and decoder cursors, driver source, chunk and frame rounding, emitter with the cursor, pending add; cursors and source released on failure. Partial: track words from the data object, and DriverAndroid returns no source, so the Android driver gives the null handle
EmitterObj C2 for the cursor overload: same body as C1 (0x86c5ec); partial for the same reasons
EmitterObj::LoadAsync: cursor, chunk size (bits*length/8 or 150 ms rounded to frames) and the buffer ring. Partial: chunk inputs come from the data object, not the cursor words

EmitterObj::Update(float): LoadAsync gate, reset, loop, 3D and DSP calls, volume/resume/pitch fades, source gain and pitch, state moves. Partial: cursor channel count (the 3D test) is read from the data object; the +0x145 flag is kept as a plain byte
